footage: Actual application browser recording; editorial title cards and captions added

capture.operational_data: All demonstrated source data, scenarios and actions are synthetic.
capture.editorial_overlay: Visible pointer/click indicator only; no values or application graphics replaced.
capture.timing_basis: Monotonic since recorded page creation; first-video-frame alignment is approximate.

chapters.title: One park, one shared picture
chapters.caption: Actual OVRTX rendering; all source data, scenarios and operational actions are synthetic.

chapters.title: Explore the connected park
chapters.caption: Orbit, zoom and click scene geometry to resolve its asset identity and connected data.

chapters.title: Selection follows the rendered scene
chapters.caption: A changing view causes retries here; selection succeeds against the current scene.

chapters.title: Compare, respond and trace
chapters.caption: Compare a modeled ride closure, apply it, dispatch maintenance and inspect the audit trail.

chapters.title: Understand utility dependencies
chapters.caption: Trace logical power dependencies, shed flexible load and simulate a water-leak repair.

chapters.title: Coordinate guests and wellbeing
chapters.caption: Respond to show-departure demand and heatwave scenarios with rerouting and qualified staff.

chapters.title: Connect inventory to operations
chapters.caption: A food-rush scenario connects queues, staffing and ERP inventory to a replenishment action.

chapters.title: Inspect sources and their quality
chapters.caption: Explore the API architecture, then pause a source and watch accepted observations become stale.

chapters.title: Replay a recorded moment
chapters.caption: Review recorded state in a shared read-only view; camera navigation remains interactive.

chapters.title: Return to live operations
chapters.caption: One asset backbone connects operations, source provenance, recorded history and the real rendered scene.
